# E0717: a field a version adds has a constraint the compiled artifact cannot check on earlier data

Data from an earlier version may already hold a field a later version
declares, carried as an extra. The compiled artifact checks such a field
against the new declaration before reading it as declared, in CEL. A
constraint CEL cannot express, here a validator call, leaves the check
unwritten, so the lineage does not compile.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
import "strings"

name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a:     string
				code?: string & strings.MinRunes(1)
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.1->0.0": {
		v0_1: _
		v0_0: {
			a: v0_1.a
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0717]: code in schema 0.1 has a constraint the compiled artifact cannot check on data from an earlier version
  --> lineage.cue:14:5
   |
14 |                 code?: string & strings.MinRunes(1)
   |                 ^^^^
   |
   = note: code in schema 0.1 is newly declared, and its acceptance check cannot express strings.MinRunes(1) (Cap'n Proto rule extras-check-unrenderable)
   = help: constrain the field with types, bounds, regular expressions and constants
```
